added.summary: An HLOD proxy's textures stream by level, as a model's `stream_textures` do, when the scene's `hlod.texels` passes the mip tail (256): spawning the scene or placing its cell loads each page's levels from 256 texels down, and the whole chain (`<page>#mips`) is read only while the proxy covers enough of the screen to want it, within the mip budget (`mip_stream`). A distant world no longer holds every proxy's full pages in GPU memory. The probe's `mip_stream:resident` makes them whole as before. Presentation only.
